response.sql: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entries, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_constructor_points FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entries) AS average_entries FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.country, rc.total_constructor_points, rc.entries, rc.entries - ra.average_entries AS difference_from_average FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rc.entries > ra.average_entries ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, rc.raceId LIMIT 10;
